anchor.comment: I like both the card is thrown and half tone shift, make another attempt with those combined
anchor.reply: Five new candidates, each one way of throwing the card and shifting the halftone in one gesture: the card is thrown and the screen jolts at the slap (recommended); thrown as a screen, it resolves at the slap; the screen tears aside for the card and shuts over it; the throw drags the screen, which locks at the stop; slapped down, the screen shuffles and locks. The throw is round one's exactly; the screen slips in hard cuts and locks, never jitters.
